start_here: Say to your AI: "I agreed to option x05-r4-1 for my film in /films/made-up-film; put it into my protected FilmCraft project cut.fcproj with the ops file ops.jsonl." It checks your own stand first and only then runs the ops headless.

lists.label: Settings
lists.holds: One row per tool and scope (a person, a film, a piece or the whole account): the settings that tool reads when it runs, as JSON.

instructions: 1. Pour the two example setting rows into your own settings list (see pour), then fill the film's row: record:setting:put-picked-options-into-a-filmcraft-project~film~<film folder name> with protected_projects and allowed_option_folders.
2. Keep your own stand on the option with tool:keep-where-you-stand, in your own words (agree is the stand that counts by default).
3. Say what you said in start_here. Your AI reads the row with tools:list, runs `pick_gate.py --film <film> check <option>` and shows what it printed.

4. Only when check says picked does it run `pick_gate.py --film <film> apply <option> --project <project> --ops <ops>`; read the line it appended to the film's apply log. A refusal means you have not picked the option: nothing was changed.

worked_examples.title: An option the person agreed to goes into the protected project; one nobody picked is refused
worked_examples.ask: Put option a, which I agreed to, into my FilmCraft project cut.fcproj with ops.jsonl.
worked_examples.given: From tools/put-picked-options-into-a-filmcraft-project/test/pick-gate.test.mjs, run for real on its made-up film with the stand-in records door and stand-in filmcraft-cli: the person's stand on 'Option  A' is agree. The AI runs `python3 tools/put-picked-options-into-a-filmcraft-project/do-work/pick_gate.py --film /films/film-one apply "option a" --project /films/film-one/filmcraft/cut.fcproj --ops /films/film-one/ops.jsonl` (the same option typed another way is the same option). For `apply cp1-c1`, which has no stand, it exits 1.
worked_examples.hands_back: Exit 0, filmcraft-cli ran `--project /films/film-one/filmcraft/cut.fcproj --save run /films/film-one/ops.jsonl`, and one line was appended to applied.jsonl: {"option_id":"option a","verdict":"agree","verdict_decision_id":"stance:film-option:1f:4959070c...","project":"/films/film-one/filmcraft/cut.fcproj","protected":true,"ops_file":"/films/film-one/ops.jsonl","ops_hash":"blake3:5a78ee24...","exit":0}. `check "option a"` printed `picked: option a (agree) decision stance:film-option:1f:4959070c...`. For cp1-c1 stderr says: pick-gate: REFUSED. Option 'cp1-c1' has no stand kept; only the person's own pick lets it into a protected project. A 'recommended' flag is not a pick. and nothing ran.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
